title: hordelymus caput-medusae
intro: Hordelymus caput-medusae, commonly known as Meadow Brome, is a perennial grass species within the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hordelymus caput-medusae include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
